flow.server: src/chaos/runState.js — sequence 3 (CHAOS_SEQUENCE_VERSION 3.0.0, CURRENT_SEQUENCE 3): applyEraReveal runs in selectCoach, not with Roll 2; sequence 2 keeps its frozen behaviour; eraWindowPhase(run) is READY for sequence 3. The era is still the seed's era (revealEra unchanged, ERA_PINS unchanged), pinned eras still travel with challenge links (chaosSequenceVersion 3.0.0). Both sides draft and choose staff era-blind: the Legend Rival prices adaptability at Roll 3 and picks its coach with eraId null; the ERA ADAPTER offer uses the era-agnostic score (existing code paths).

portraits.what: 24 generated ARCHETYPE placeholders — one guard (PG/SG), one wing (SF), one big (PF/C) per decade 1950s–2020s — faceless, era-styled, non-identifying figures on the dark portrait well. Generated with Recraft v4 through the owner's media connector (240 credits from the existing balance; 10 per image). Renditions: 336×456 JPEG for the card zone, 96×96 JPEG for the phone row.
portraits.policy: docs/IMAGES.md Tier 4: never a likeness of a real athlete (the policy forbids generated likenesses; these depict nobody and carry no face, name, number or team mark). An approved photograph (approved.json) always resolves first; the initials silhouette remains the fallback when a file fails.
portraits.mapping: src/ui/time-arena/placeholders.js: decade + primary position → image; a stable per-player mirror flip adds variety. Coverage: 381/381 players → 24 images (e.g. 2020s-guard 34 players, 1950s-wing 1).
